content_of_post_to_comment: You're going to be the villain in some people's stories and there's literally nothing you can do about it. You cannot explain or apologize your way out of their perception. Let them misunderstand you. Let them speak ill about you. Let them overlook you. It's not your job to manage their thoughts. Be true to yourself, to what's good. Time will vindicate you.
comment: There's an interesting line between accepting that people misunderstand you and using that as a shield from accountability. Maybe the real challenge is knowing when to let go and when to listen.
